name: search_runbooks
description: Search the Kafka ops knowledge base for runbooks, playbooks, and operational procedures. Use this when the user asks how to perform an operation and you need more specific context than what was already provided.
prompt_context: When the user asks about Kafka operational procedures, troubleshooting steps, or configuration guidance, use search_runbooks to find the most relevant documentation. Return results from runbooks, playbooks, incident reports, and configuration references. Always cite the source document.

query.description: Natural language search query describing what the user needs

category.description: Filter results by document category. Use 'all' if unsure.

name: lookup_kafka_config
description: Look up a specific Kafka configuration key and return its description, default value, and recommended value for our environment. Covers broker, topic, producer, consumer, and Kafka Streams configs.
prompt_context: When the user asks about a specific Kafka configuration property (e.g. retention.ms, min.insync.replicas, max.poll.records), use lookup_kafka_config to return its official description, default value, valid values, and the recommended setting for our environment. Always explain the impact of changing it.

name: list_consumer_groups
description: List all consumer groups in the Kafka cluster. Returns group IDs and their current state (Stable, Rebalancing, Empty, Dead).
prompt_context: Use list_consumer_groups when the user asks to see all consumer groups, wants to know what groups exist, or needs to find a specific group name.

name: describe_consumer_group
description: Describe a specific consumer group. Returns state, members, assigned partitions, current offsets, log end offsets, and lag per partition.
prompt_context: Use describe_consumer_group when the user asks about a specific consumer group's status, its members, which partitions are assigned, or its overall health. This also shows per-partition lag.

group_id.description: The consumer group ID to describe

name: list_topics
description: List all topics in the Kafka cluster. Returns topic names, partition counts, and replication factors.
prompt_context: Use list_topics when the user asks to see all topics, wants to know what topics exist, or needs to find a specific topic.

name: get_consumer_lag
description: Get the current consumer lag for a specific consumer group. Returns per-partition lag (difference between log end offset and committed offset) and total lag across all partitions.
prompt_context: Use get_consumer_lag when the user asks specifically about consumer lag, backlog, or how far behind a consumer group is. This provides a focused view of lag numbers.

group_id.description: The consumer group ID to check lag for

name: describe_topic
description: Describe a specific Kafka topic. Returns partition details (leader, replicas, ISR, offline replicas) and non-default topic configurations.
prompt_context: Use describe_topic when the user asks about a specific topic's details, partition layout, replica assignment, ISR status, or topic-level configuration overrides.
